title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Tier Credited Back on a Room Change
content:
**Tier pricing note, room changes — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The come-off tier of a room-change credit — the tier whose daily rate is given back for the days moved off the old room's charge — follows the charge itself.

- Where the charge's tier is not the agreement's current tier, the come-off tier is the charge's tier.
- Where the charge is for the agreement's current tier and carries the isolation charge basis, the come-off tier is the agreement's isolation billing tier.
- Otherwise the come-off tier is the agreement's own tier.

| Agreement's tier | Its isolation billing tier |
|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room |

**Points of judgement.** A charge posted for the tier the resident moved out of, the agreement now recording the new tier: the come-off tier is the charge's tier. A charge for the agreement's current tier carrying the isolation charge basis: read the agreement's tier in the table above. A charge for the agreement's current tier at the standard basis: the agreement's own tier.
